name: Deep Glass
description: Clear scene + local glass UI. The wallpaper/video stays optically clear in open areas; the sidebar, composer, cards and dialogs are the glass surfaces. Still recognizably Harness.
components: #root [contenteditable="true"], #root textarea { border-radius: 14px; } #root [contenteditable="true"]:focus, #root textarea:focus { background: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3, rgba(255,255,255,0.9)); } #root pre, #root pre code { background: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3, rgba(40,40,44,0.85)); } #root :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary, rgb(77,124,254)); } #root ::selection { background: var(--dsw-alias-state-business-tertiary, rgba(77,124,254,0.22)); }
motion: @keyframes hd-deep-glass-pan { from { background-position: 0% 0%; } to { background-position: 100% 100%; } } #root > * { background-size: 180% 180%; animation: hd-deep-glass-pan 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #root > * { animation: none; } }
